lakes.name: 未名湖
lakes.how: the inner ground's body (ground.json): the lake crosses the domain's edge

join_inner_step_m.how: every 2.5 m of the domain's edge: the inner ground there (ground_edge.json: land, or the bed where a lake crosses the edge) against the ring's own surface (cm-rounded, its cell triangles); the view meets the inner mesh's own edge vertices, so the drawn seam is closed either way

dem_limits: GLO-30 is a surface model (TanDEM-X 2011-15), 1 arc second (about 24 x 31 m here): roofs and tree crowns are in it.
Ring: the DEM only on massifs holding a named OSM peak, after a grey opening of 80 m (buildings and crowns narrower than that removed; a forest canopy stays, some 5-15 m too high).

万寿山 carries today's temples rebuilt in the 1880s-90s (佛香阁 on its terrace) and today's trees; its earth was heaped in 1750 from the lake: the hill is the one of 1860 within the DEM's error, the buildings are not modelled.
Everything else in the ring is the plane of the inner ground (research/terrain/plain.json) extended: today's city, fill, cuttings and modern reservoirs are ignored, and so is any small rise of 1860.
Backdrop: the DEM after an opening of 450 m and a smoothing of about 60 m: the ranges' silhouette, not their detail; it is drawn under fog.
